metadata.description: Testimonials from users of the AI Safety Atlas in Impact page.

content.quote: This was my first time reading the AI Safety Atlas and wow!!! It has so many insightful information and citations that I am looking forward to diving deeper into.
For a "systematic", centralized, and concise introduction to the core topics in AI safety, this is the best and most up-to-date resource I know.
As an AI safety research engineer, I find it a pretty good in-depth introduction. It covers a lot in a very clear way.
